paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut, Hosea, remez 528; Hyman says the reading should be “R' Berekhyah in the name of R' Abbahu.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The saved Yalkut Shimoni on Nach digital text at remez 528 reads ר׳ הונא ור׳ ברכיה בריה דר׳ אבהו, including “son of Rabbi Abbahu.” Hyman’s heading gives bar Avuha; he proposes replacing the patronymic with “in the name of Rabbi Abbahu.”

The actual Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 528 paragraph has the abbreviated titles in ר' ברכיה בריה דר' אבהו, a son-of formula. Hyman’s bar Avuha heading and his proposed in-the-name-of formula remain distinct. The new heading and body deliberately retain R' for the unexpanded titles; the earlier note is retained verbatim as historical editorial wording. No patronymic is converted into a transmission relationship or new identity.
